context: Add explicit columns for the legacy optional frontmatter, or document a one-to-one mapping into existing columns, BEFORE the importer is written against this spec. Cross-check the full legacy corpus for any other optional key that lacks a home.
description:
chatgpt-codex-connector review finding on merged PR #1271 (P2, _project/specs/findings-domain.md:95). Deferred from the PR-review sweep in PR #1292 because defining where these fields live IS the migration contract, and picking it unilaterally pre-empts the domain design; tracked in GitHub issue #1293.

The proposed findings / finding_evidence schema has no lossless home for existing optional frontmatter such as related_paths and suggested_sweep (allowed today by _project/blind-spots/README.md:61-63 and used throughout the legacy corpus), yet phase 5 promises every frontmatter field is preserved. When the importer is implemented against this work order, those fields will be dropped or squeezed into unrelated text/evidence rows, so the parity gate cannot pass.
Thread: https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/pull/1271#discussion_r3634254555

anti_patterns.dont: squeeze related_paths or suggested_sweep into a free-text/evidence row
anti_patterns.instead: add explicit columns or document an exact one-to-one mapping
anti_patterns.why: the phase-5 parity gate promises field-level preservation, which free text cannot satisfy

preserves.behavior: Every optional frontmatter key in the legacy corpus round-trips losslessly under the documented mapping

verifications.description: Every optional key in the legacy corpus has a documented home
verifications.expected: each listed key appears in the mapping table in _project/specs/findings-domain.md

work_units.evidence: Inventoried the live 65-record corpus: 13 validator-accepted frontmatter keys, 8 distinct body headings. Measured loss under parse_draft: 65/65 records; related_paths 170 entries, suggested_sweep 11,559 chars, todo_id 36 records (19 unique targets, 0 dangling), 8 stray sections 5,779 chars.
work_units.summary: Inventory every optional frontmatter key used across the legacy _project/blind-spots corpus and check each against the proposed schema

work_units.evidence: Documented an exact one-to-one mapping in _project/specs/findings-domain.md 'Legacy field mapping (schema v4)': explicit related_paths/suggested_sweep columns plus a finding_sections table (owner decision 2026-07-29), and todo_id -> finding_links with kind by status (32 promoted-to, 4 resolved-by). No free-text/evidence-row fold.
work_units.summary: Add explicit columns or a documented one-to-one mapping so every key round-trips losslessly

work_units.evidence: Added a falsifiable parity criterion to the spec (round-trip reproduces every key with list order, every section byte-for-byte, each triage-log line as one finding_events row; unmapped-key and unmapped-section counts must both be zero) and wired it into the phase-5 gate list.
work_units.summary: State the parity-gate criterion in the spec so the importer can be checked against it
